fields.name: Massage
fields.notes: Massaging client or patient to improve circulation, soothe or stimulate nerves, facilitate elimination of waste matter, stretch contracted tendons and produce other therapeutic effects.

fields.name: Prenatal Care
fields.notes: Checking on general health and progress of expectant mothers during pregnancy, and giving them professional advice and care.

fields.name: Dental Hygiene
fields.notes: Helping patients prepare for examination or treatment.

fields.name: Oral Surgery
fields.notes: Giving surgical treatment for particular types of dental and oral diseases and disorders.

fields.name: Word Processing
fields.notes: Typing, editing, and printing various documents using word-processing equipment, or send and receive messages and facsimiles by means of a teleprinter, telefax or similar machines.

fields.name: Bookkeeping
fields.notes: Maintaining complete records of all financial transactions of an undertaking according to general bookkeeping principles.

fields.name: Family Planning Counseling
fields.notes: Advising on and administering birth control methods.

fields.name: Nutrition
fields.notes: Participating in programmes for nutrition education and nutrition rehabilitation activities.

fields.name: Drug Testing
fields.notes: Testing drugs to determine identity, purity and strength.

fields.name: Diagnosis
fields.notes: Conducting medical examinations and making diagnoses.

fields.name: Scheduling
fields.notes: Screening requests for meetings, scheduling and organising meetings, scheduling and organising meetings and travel arrangements for the head of unit and other members of staff.

fields.name: Accounts Controlling
fields.notes: Advising on, planning and installing budgetary, accounts controlling and other accounting policies and systems.

fields.name: Budgeting
fields.notes: Preparing budgets and overseeing various financial operations.

fields.name: Research
fields.notes: Conducting research into human disorders and illnesses and preventive or curative methods.

fields.name: Auditing
fields.notes: Auditing accounts and book-keeping records.

fields.name: Postnatal Care
fields.notes: Attending mothers in the post-natal period to supervise their recovery, to check on babies' progress, and to instruct parents in baby care.

fields.name: Planning
fields.notes: Planning, directing and coordinating the internal administration or financial operations of the enterprise or organisation.

fields.name: Dispensing
fields.notes: Dispensing medicaments and drugs in hospitals or selling them in pharmacies.

fields.name: Preventive Medicine
fields.notes: Advising communities and individuals on birth control, hygiene, diet and other preventive medical measures.

fields.name: Technical Support
fields.notes: Installing computers and performing diagnostics on computer hardware.

fields.name: Documentation
fields.notes: Writing and providing detailed documentation of computer programs.

fields.name: Eye Examination
fields.notes: Examining eyes and prescribing glasses, contact lenses or other treatment to improve vision.

fields.name: Data Entry
fields.notes: Entering numerical and other data from source material into computer-compatible storage and processing devices.

fields.name: Cashier
fields.notes: Receiving incoming cash of an establishment, checking it against sales slips and other documents, and preparing it for deposit at bank.

fields.name: Inventory Management
fields.notes: Purchasing or controlling the purchase of supplies; controlling storage and issue of supplies.

fields.name: Security
fields.notes: Patrolling buildings and areas to prevent theft, violence, infractions of rules or other irregularities.
